scope_lock.objective: Correct RAC-002 through RAC-005 so runtime asset authority is ancestor-safe, exhaustively attributable, audit-bound, and backed by a verifiable extraction-receipt schema without hydrating any asset.
required_behavior: Use one shared component-wise no-follow reader for roots, manifest, config, dvc.lock, audit authority, inventory authority, extraction receipt, and every asset member; reject a symlink in any component from filesystem anchor to target and detect between-open drift.

Create one tracked canonical audit-authority config derived deterministically from audit b2c274ab and bind its raw bytes, strict schema, source-audit SHA, source inventory SHA, class IDs, consumers, audiences, roots, rules, counts, and audit inventory digests from the manifest.

Create one tracked exhaustive native DataDir inventory authority with every relative file and directory member, type, mode, size, and file SHA-256. Its canonical digest must reproduce audit source inventory 5cf47e7d and its VMAP subset must reproduce the audited 17,640-file closure.
For complete-directory classes, compare exact expected file and directory members and report every missing, extra, type, mode, size, and content delta together before aggregate summaries.

Define a deterministic extraction-receipt producer in the runtime_asset_closure module. A receipt must bind the tracked inventory authority SHA, full recomputed DataDir inventory excluding only the receipt itself, client identity, extractor identity, creation command inputs, and schema.

The verifier must require the extraction receipt raw SHA pinned by the committed manifest, rehash its bytes, strictly validate it, and recompute its full DataDir inventory. A null or absent pinned receipt SHA remains a typed provenance_missing blocker for the current source and cannot be treated as approval.
Keep the current real read-only scan reporting all exact 13 retained missing inputs and the missing or unpinned native extraction receipt in one result while confirming every present class.
Preserve parameterized map contracts and all existing exact-file, bounded-pattern, DVC, DataDir, bundle, snapshot, duplicate-key, traversal, and no-copy properties.
deterministic_fixtures: Remove two named complete-directory members, substitute one same-count file, and add an empty directory; one receipt names every exact member delta and aggregate mismatch.
Place every root and authority file in turn beneath a symlinked parent; each fails with a typed symlink/root identity issue before authorization.
Missing, same-size modified, wrong-schema, and class/rule/digest-disagreeing audit authorities all fail closed.
A fabricated extraction receipt with correct literals but changed non-scenario DataDir content, client identity, extractor identity, inventory authority, or receipt bytes fails closed.
A producer-generated pinned fixture receipt passes only while all bound bytes and physical paths remain exact.

explicitly_deferred.reason: Mandatory propagation spans the separately enumerated 12 executable surfaces and will be the next non-overlapping work unit after this shared authority foundation is committed.
explicitly_deferred.safety: No runtime or hydration is authorized between the two corrections.

forbidden_changes: No edits outside the exact six owned paths.
No command-generator, entrypoint-mandatory-mode, gameplay, encounter, class, role, roster, or movement change.
No asset hydration or copy, DVC operation, database access, provisioning, build, capture, worldserver start, or live canary.
Do not fabricate or install a real native extraction receipt; only define and fixture-test its producer and verifier.
acceptance_conditions: RAC-002, RAC-003, RAC-004, and RAC-005 deterministic fixtures pass with no weakening of current positive behavior.
The real scan exits typed incomplete, names all 13 retained inputs and native provenance blocker together, and introduces no asset or runtime mutation.
Exactly the six owned paths change in one commit and the worktree is clean.
RAC-001 remains explicitly unresolved and no live, hydration, or checklist acceptance claim is made.

terminal_conditions.success: Return one committed authority-hardening correction with exact validation results and RAC-001 still blocked.
terminal_conditions.failed_verification: Stop with a typed correction failure and the earliest violated property without broadening scope.
terminal_conditions.out_of_scope: Report command propagation, real receipt creation, hydration, DVC publication, or live needs without acting on them.

next_action: Dispatch one Sol high raid-shard-architecture implementer, then authorize the separate mandatory command-propagation correction for RAC-001.
